tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search every site's catalogue at once for a product, brand or kind of product (typos are corrected per site). Returns products with their site, page URL, manufacturer list price and a summary of current shop offers in the locale's market (shops, buyable, lowest total incl. known shipping). Name one

tools.name: find_by_code
tools.description: Exact identity lookup on every site: a GTIN/EAN barcode, a manufacturer item number or a LEGO set number. Returns each site's matching product with its current shop offers in the locale's market (cheapest total first, each with its link) and the best price overall. Never a guess: no match means no s

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Shop prices of one product version side by side in the locale's market on the site that lists it (cheapest total first, out of stock last; price, shipping, stock, when checked and the shop link), plus the same version's best price in that site's other markets.

tools.name: compare_across_sites
tools.description: One product on every site that lists it, merged: the product (photos, versions, specifications), every shop's offer for one version in the locale's market across those sites (cheapest total first, out of stock last, each shop once, with the site that lists it, that site's product page and its shop l

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: The departments of the whole network (electronics, home, toys, fashion, …) with the categories of their sites in the locale's language: key, name, parent, number of products and the sites that have it. Use browse_category for a category's products.

tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: One page of a category's products across every site of its department that has the category (products with a shop offer in the locale's market first), with their lowest offer, site and page URL, the subcategories and whether there are more pages.

tools.name: best_deals
tools.description: The largest real price drops right now in the locale's market across the sites: a shop's price against its own lowest price of the 30 days before (never a shop's own "was" price), with the site, product page and shop link.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "find_by_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, browse_category · Public sink: search_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, browse_category · Public sink: search_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
